analysis.title: Macro Volatility Digest: Volatilities Fall on Oil/Yield Reprieve as the S&P Rallies Into Earnings Season
key_insights: Implied volatilities fell across the major asset classes in the week to Oct 9 as rates and oil, the two main drivers of cross-asset volatility spillover, both eased.

The MOVE Index fell 9 points to 98 (94th percentile) from its 2nd-highest level YTD, as the 10-year yield retraced from Monday's 24-year peak of 5.35% after a strong 10-year auction (bid-to-cover 2.77, highest since 2016).
The 10-year tenor carries a 40% weight in the MOVE Index, so the auction had an outsized effect on stabilizing rates vol.
The OVX fell from the 50th to the 43rd percentile. Most of the front-month vol pullback was priced before Trump ruled out a strike on Iran before the midterm elections.
Cboe sees the muted vol reaction and the stickiness of longer-dated oil vol to the Iran pledge as a sign that it defers supply disruption risk rather than removing it.
Dec year-end oil skew became more convex w/w: ATM vols dropped while deep out-of-the-money puts and calls stayed near week-ago levels.

The VIX fell 0.5 pts w/w to 14.8 but lagged skew-implied levels by 0.5 pts. Given the S&P 500's +1.2% weekly gain, the skew implied a 1pt VIX drop to 14.3. Cboe attributes the gap to opportunistic buying of downside convexity.
1M S&P 500 30-delta skew steepened slightly from the 9th to the 15th percentile, showing marginal demand for downside protection.
With 3 weeks to the midterm elections, the vol term structure implies a one-day post-election move of 1.2, about 1.3x a typical day in the current vol regime, so election expectations are muted.

Dispersion rose w/w and 1M implied correlation (COR1M) fell to 6.93% (10th percentile lows) on OpenAI's revenue scare. The gap vs expectations came from an accounting definition rather than lost sales.
The outsized reaction and uneven recovery among chip and semi names show greater stock differentiation heading into Q3 earnings.
Biggest 1M implied vol drops: EWZ -19.9 pts to 38.8, MXEF -4.2, USO -4.7, TLT -2.5, LQD -1.6, HYG -1.5.
earnings_insights: Cboe expects stock dispersion to stay elevated into Q3 earnings season, led by AI and tech names after the OpenAI revenue scare. No specific EPS or revenue figures are given.

Highest bid-to-cover since 2016, showing strong demand and helping stabilize rates vol.

risk_factors: Iran supply disruption risk is deferred rather than removed, as shown by sticky longer-dated oil vol.
Rates volatility is still at the 94th percentile and could reignite cross-asset vol contagion.
Rising dispersion and low implied correlation into Q3 earnings, with AI and tech names reacting sharply to single-stock news such as OpenAI's revenue scare.
Opportunistic demand for downside convexity in S&P options.

1M S&P 500 30-delta skew rose from the 9th to the 15th percentile.
OVX at the 43rd percentile, down from the 50th. Dec oil skew is more convex, with ATM vol lower and DOTM puts and calls unchanged.
COR1M 6.93% (10th percentile lows) with dispersion rising.

Implied-realized spreads: SPX +1.8 (realized 10.1), RTY +6.6 (realized 11.3), QQQ +2.4, MXEF +5.0, EWZ -9.6 (realized 48.5), TLT +2.1.
geopolitical: Trump announced he is ruling out a strike on Iran before the midterm elections. Cboe says this defers rather than removes the oil supply disruption risk.
US midterm elections are about three weeks away.
